purpose: Fail-closed contract for the full, sharded PCQM4Mv2 geometry-only pretokenizer release with content-addressed per-record motif binding. This contract version-bumps the bounded smoke boundary; it does not itself admit P1 training.

source.companion_row_rule: source-contract v3 locks csv_idx as zero-based contiguous and train split as the contiguous prefix [0,3378606), therefore official_csv_row_index equals SDF ordinal; no derived row-map is a staged source role

execution.architecture: one ordered tar.gz producer, bounded ProcessPool workers, and one LMDB writer in the parent process
execution.partial_attempt_policy: preserve every incomplete attempt; never reuse or relabel it; restart that shard in a fresh attempt directory

shard_artifacts.partition: each source ordinal has exactly one membership disposition; admits have one LMDB payload and payload-index row; rejects have one reject-ledger row
shard_artifacts.motif_census: content-addressed digest-to-exact-fragment dictionary and aggregate counts from admitted records only; each admitted payload stores only its ordered digest sequence

release_states.partial: production_scope.json and run_state.json exist, but full_release_manifest.json does not
release_states.complete: all shard manifests cover [0,required_record_count) without gap or overlap and full_release_manifest.json binds every completed shard plus the global motif census

fail_closed: Every staged input file is byte-counted and SHA-256 verified before SDF, CSV, or row-map parsing.
The output root must be new unless --resume is explicit.
Resume validates every completed shard artifact and restarts only at a completed shard boundary.
Any worker, serialization, ordering, LMDB, range, contract, or invariant error stops the release and records only a closed failure class.
Every per-record motif digest is SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 motif fragment, preserves motif order, and has the same cardinality as motif_atom_indices.
Any malformed motif digest or digest-to-distinct-fragment collision stops the release.
No completed shard is overwritten, appended, merged, or silently repaired.
A complete manifest is impossible unless the global ranges are exactly contiguous and the membership partition balances.
